prompts.map-detail-la.jpg: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square raster texture for a tactical map, viewed vertically downward from many kilometers overhead. Primary request: create one seamless tile of very low contrast ground microdetail, fully filled edge to edge with ground, orthographic aerial scan, no perspective or horizon. The terrain will be multiplied over a colored elevation map, so use near-neutral light gray midtones with only subtle muted tint, fine detailed organic patterns, restrained 6% tonal variation, no dark shadows, no lighting gradient, no directional light, no border, no text, no UI, no grid, no icons, no landmarks. All ground features very small and evenly distributed, avoid obvious repetition. Original design, no reference to existing games. Los Angeles dry terrain: faint patchwork of desiccated fields and sand, fine dry scrub, tiny worn dirt traces, softly eroded hills. Slight warm gray ivory tone; not a landscape photo.
